page_title: EVE 2-0 NOT | Everton v Nottingham Forest 21/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+18' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+16' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Chermiti (Everton) is given a yellow card.
90+11' Anthony Taylor shows a yellow card to Murillo (Nottingham) for his blatant foul.
90+10' Beto (Everton) is being substituted because of an injury. Sean Dyche sends Chermiti on the pitch.
90+9' The game gets underway again after that interruption.
90+4' We are going to have a delay to proceedings as we have an injury to a player.
90+4' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
90+3' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
90+3' Beto (Everton) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90' 9 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
89' Neco Williams (Nottingham) picks up an injury.
86' It seemed like Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
83' The linesman points to the corner flag, Everton are going to take it.
82' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jack Harrison (Everton) was quite harsh and Anthony Taylor didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
82' Everton couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Matz Sels (Nottingham) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
81' It must be a yellow card. It is. Ryan Yates (Nottingham) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
80' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to substitute Callum Hudson-Odoi and he is replaced by Divock Origi (Nottingham).
80' Substitution. Rodrigo Ribeiro (Nottingham) in, Danilo out.
80' The referee has issued a yellow card to Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton).
80' We are about to witness a substitution. Ryan Yates (Nottingham) is replacing Nicolas Dominguez.
80' PENALTY APPEAL after Chris Wood (Nottingham) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
78' Dwight McNeil (Everton) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Matz Sels easily deals with the threat.

76' 2 - 0 Dwight McNeil (Everton) produces a wonderful finish! He received a pass from Abdoulaye Doucoure and unleashed a fantastic long-range strike into the bottom right corner via the post. The score is 2:0.
74' Tempers flare after a clattering challenge by Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton), who receives a yellow card from the referee. It could have been worse for him!
73' The attendance is 39239.
72' Jack Harrison (Everton) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
70' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Chris Wood.
67' Substitution. Andre Gomes makes way for James Garner (Everton).
67' Here is a change. Dominic Calvert-Lewin is going off and Sean Dyche gives the last tactical orders to Beto (Everton).
65' Flag goes up against Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
65' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
63' Great teamplay by Nottingham as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
63' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) is able to continue to play.
61' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
60' What a big chance! Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
59' Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
57' Looks like Jarrad Branthwaite (Everton) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
55' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
55' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) picks up a lucky rebound inside the box from the clearance, beats an opponent but drills his shot inches wide of the left post.
54' Corner kick. Dwight McNeil (Everton) is ready to send the ball into the box.
54' Jack Harrison (Everton) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is out of play and Everton manage to earn a corner.
53' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) is coming onto the pitch as Giovanni Reyna cannot continue after picking up an injury.
51' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
48' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Danilo (Nottingham) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.
45+2' The corner from Danilo (Nottingham) is cleared away by the defence.
45+2' Nottingham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
45' Nottingham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
44' Ashley Young (Everton) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the referee wasn't in the best position. Let's see what he decides.
44' Total attempts – 3:5.
40' Chris Wood (Nottingham) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and fires a quick shot to the left post. His promising effort is kept out by Jordan Pickford, who pulls off a stunning save!
38' Abdoulaye Doucoure (Everton) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
36' A lofted cross from Jack Harrison (Everton) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
35' Andre Gomes (Everton) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
33' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle. Ashley Young (Everton) commits a foul after dangerous play.

29' 1 - 0 Idrissa Gueye (Everton) waited for a rebound on the edge of the box and left the goalkeeper stranded with his beautiful attempt which went into the bottom left corner, glancing off the post.
29' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.

28' Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Matz Sels, who pulls off a comfortable save!
27' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 1:1.
24' PENALTY APPEAL by Nottingham, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
20' Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) takes a snap shot from the edge of the box after a rebound, but his effort is a waste as it goes high over the bar.
19' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Everton out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.

18' Moussa Niakhate (Nottingham) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Anthony Taylor with no other option than to blow for a foul.
16' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) but poses no threat.
14' Andre Gomes (Everton) fires the ball in from a mid-range free kick, but it blazes over the bar.
14' Andre Gomes (Everton) takes the ball and sets it for the free kick.
13' Neco Williams (Nottingham) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play. Everton earn a free kick.
13' Dwight McNeil (Everton) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
13' The Everton players are exchanging some short passes.
11' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle as Dominic Calvert-Lewin (Everton) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
10' Andre Gomes (Everton) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
9' Dwight McNeil (Everton) takes the corner kick, but Matz Sels reads it well and stops the effort.
7' Everton force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
6' Jack Harrison (Everton) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
6' Jack Harrison (Everton) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
5' Neco Williams (Nottingham) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Jordan Pickford makes a comfortable save.
4' Neco Williams (Nottingham) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
2' Chris Wood (Nottingham) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Anthony Taylor blows for a foul.
1' A player from Everton commits a rough challenge. Anthony Taylor blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Nottingham will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Anthony Taylor.
